div.head: Af 57
div.ab: Gif se scytefinger biþ ofaslægen, seo bot bið XV scll'; his nægles bið V scll'.
Gif se scytefinger bið ófaslegen, sio bót bið XV scill.; his nægles bið III scill.
Si secundus digitus (id est index uel salutatorius) amputetur, XV sol. culpa sit; unguis eius III solid.
Gif se scytefinger bið ófaslegen, sio bót bið XV scill; his nægles bið III scill.
If the “shooting finger” is struck off, the compensation is 15 shillings; its nail is 3 shillings.
If the first finger is struck off, the compensation [to be paid] shall be 15 shillings; for the nail of the same, 3 shillings [compensation shall be paid].
Wenn der Zeigefinger abgeschlagen ist, ist die Busse 15 Schill.; [die] seines Nagels ist 3 Schill.
If the forefinger is struck off, the compensation is 15 shillings; [that] for its nail is 3 shillings.
